thinkingSteps.body: For “Counting Bits”, first say a correct slow approach: scan or retry every candidate until the example works by hand. Input n = 2 should still produce [0,1,1].

thinkingSteps.title: Why it is slow
thinkingSteps.body: Count the nested work. If each choice restarts a full scan, time blows up. Name the cost before optimizing — interviewers want that honesty. Target after the insight: See code.

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To count the number of 1 bits for each number in the range [0, num], we can use dynamic programming. We observe that the number of 1 bits in a number x is equal to the number of 1 bits in x // 2 plus the value of the least significant bit (x % 2).
